title: An Intelligent System for Prediction of Severity of SARS-Cov-2 Infection and Progression to Critical Illness: Using Machine Learning Models
summary: Machine-learning models using clinical and laboratory features predicted SARS-CoV-2 severity and progression to critical illness; the preprint reports cohort-specific performance and predictors.
ai_technology: Machine-learning models use clinical and laboratory measurements to predict COVID-19 severity and progression to critical illness.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the indexed abstract reviewed

evidence.tested: The preprint reports cohort-specific prediction of severity and critical illness from clinical and laboratory features.
evidence.unknown: The evidence is limited to the reported cohorts and predictor evaluation; prospective deployment benefit is not established.
evidence.ai_role: Machine-learning models use clinical and laboratory measurements to predict COVID-19 severity and progression to critical illness.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
